The ultimate side hustle: get paid to share your perspective

 

Enjoy making money online in your free time! Best-in-class companies rely on UserTesting to gain valuable insights into their products from people like you! New test opportunities are posted every day from companies around the world.

 

Apply 

Submit your email and take a quick practice test to join our global network of trusted contributors. As long as you’re at least 18 years old, you don’t need any special experience to get paid to test. UserTesting customers want to gather your unique perspective, so all you need to do is share your thoughts out loud using your mobile or desktop device, no prior experience required!

 

Browse

Answer screening questions to match with test opportunities. New tests are released all the time! To earn money online as a website tester (and apps and in-person experiences, too) you need a device with a microphone and an active PayPal account.

 

Test

Share your perspectives via tests you match with, and help best-in-class brands improve their products and services. UserTesting is one of the best ways to earn money online fast. On average, most contributors take one or two tests per week. You can receive a test at any time, on any day of the week. However, the number of opportunities is dependent on the needs of UserTesting customers, including your demographic profile and background. Keep in mind, the more complete your profile is, the more tests you’ll qualify for to make money online.

 

Make money online

Get rewarded for different types of tests! Your test feed will show you the amount you'll get paid for each test. All contributors receive payments in USD through PayPal (you can then convert to your local currency via PayPal if desired). You must have a confirmed PayPal account that’s in good standing to receive payments. We recommend using a verified personal PayPal account.

Turn Your Feedback Into Cash with Userlytics!

Userlytics gives you a voice in shaping the future of mobile apps, websites, and digital experiences. As a registered panelist or invited guest, you can test new designs, share your thoughts out loud, and get paid for helping top global brands build better products.

Why test with Userlytics?

• Transparent Rewards: Earn money for every study completed. Track your total balance, view pending payouts, and check your complete earnings history directly in your personalized Financial Dashboard.
• Instant Test Discovery: Find available surveys, self-guided usability sessions, and 1-on-1 moderated live interviews right on your Home screen.
• Never Miss a Paid Session: Instant access and clear schedules for Booked Live Conversations, ensuring you join on time and get paid.
• Frictionless Testing Setup: Fast, 3-step automatic device checks for internet connection, camera preview, microphone levels, and screen recording permissions.
• Seamless Account Autonomy: Log in securely with your credentials, update your profile, or reset your password directly within the app.
• Direct Support: Get one-tap access to our Help Desk whenever you need technical assistance.

How it works:

1. Log in or enter a study code: Access your panel account or join as an invited guest using an 8-digit study code.
2. Complete the device setup: Verify your camera, mic, and internet connection in seconds.
3. Take the test: Share your honest opinion out loud while completing simple tasks.
4. Get paid: Track your reward status in the Rewards tab as soon as your study upload completes!

Note for Guests: Have an 8-digit invitation code? Select "Enter invitation code" on the welcome screen to jump straight into your assigned study without creating an account.

Download the newly redesigned Userlytics app today and start earning rewards for your opinion!
